verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm Cekura serves an llms.txt at docs.cekura.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Its doc pages are also available as raw markdown, and each one points agents to the llms.txt documentation index. An OpenAPI spec and a dedicated guide for using Cekura from AI coding agents add further agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs successfully, and no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
